title: Racing Through the Storm
description: A large stylized white character with a minimalist face and black hair stands in pouring rain, wearing a red race car numbered 07 as a collar. The surreal landscape features blue mountains, orange hills, two large turquoise flowers, and a bright yellow sun with radiating beams under a colorful sky.
prompt: Surreal pop art painting of a giant minimalist white character with a simple black line face and spiky hair, looking surprised as a red Ferrari race car with number 07 drives through its neck like a collar, splashing water in heavy rain. Two large turquoise flowers flank the scene, with blue and orange mountains in the background and a bright glowing yellow sun with rays in a colorful sky.
